title: Correctly handle ScriptScoreQuery in plain highlighter

timeline.message: Correctly handle ScriptScoreQuery in plain highlighter
timeline.author: Alan Woodward

diff.patch:
@@ -652,7 +652,7 @@ public void onRemoval(ShardId shardId, Accountable accountable) {
             mapperService,
             mapperService.mappingLookup(),
             similarityService,
-            null,
+            MapperServiceTestCase.this::compileScript,
             parserConfig(),
             writableRegistry(),
             null,

timeline.body:
ScriptScoreQuery is an elasticsearch query implementation that the plain
highlighter doesn't know anything about.  To highlight it correctly, we need
to add some custom handling logic in our CustomQueryScorer.

Fixes #99700

timeline.body: Hi @romseygeek, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Note that these changes (replacing a reference to the concrete ScriptService class with one to its ScriptCompiler interface instead) make using scripts in tests a lot easier.
timeline.diff_hunk:
@@ -110,7 +110,7 @@ public SearchExecutionContext(
         MapperService mapperService,
         MappingLookup mappingLookup,
         SimilarityService similarityService,
-        ScriptService scriptService,
+        ScriptCompiler scriptService,

timeline.body: There are almost certainly other places where we are using a `ScriptService` when we could quite happily be using a `ScriptCompiler`, and replacing things there would probably simplify a whole bunch of tests.
